import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,time
started=time.perf_counter()
handle='rcle-b06-nearest99-s26-20260911'
source='baf63642a776ef3e60f4310ce47d76c45168c283'
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/wu/projects/HMASD')
cwd=pathlib.Path('/home/wu/hmasd-worktrees/rcle-b06-nearest99-s26-20260911')
stage=pathlib.Path('/home/wu/hmasd-inputs/rcle-b06-nearest99-s26-20260911')
supervisor=pathlib.Path('/home/wu/.agent-tasks')/handle
steps=[]
def call(argv,expected=0):
 r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=max(1,15-(time.perf_counter()-started)))
 steps.append({'argv':argv,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
 assert r.returncode==expected,(argv,r.returncode,r.stderr)
 return r.stdout
for path,parent in [(cwd,'/home/wu/hmasd-worktrees'),(stage,'/home/wu/hmasd-inputs')]:
 assert path.name==handle and path.parent==pathlib.Path(parent)
 assert not path.is_symlink() and path.is_dir() and path.resolve(strict=True)==path
assert (supervisor/'status').read_text().strip()=='finished'
assert (supervisor/'exit_code').read_text().strip()=='0'
call(['tmux','has-session','-t','=agent_'+handle],expected=1)
assert call(['git','-C',str(cwd),'rev-parse','HEAD']).strip()==source
assert call(['git','-C',str(cwd),'status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])==''
before=call(['git','-C',str(repo),'worktree','list','--porcelain'])
assert 'worktree '+str(cwd)+'\n' in before
expected_hashes={'source.bundle':'9e22ced7157debd250e289f57855ef513e36ba7dfc575da5b8921b21b2feffd6','terminal.tar.gz':'4c3188b056ccc91a67482663a3d97f9d38f216d41b55b331127ab1b744202494'}
assert {p.name for p in stage.iterdir()}==set(expected_hashes)
for name,digest in expected_hashes.items():
 p=stage/name
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
call(['git','-C',str(repo),'worktree','remove','--force',str(cwd)])
for name in ['source.bundle','terminal.tar.gz']:
 (stage/name).unlink()
stage.rmdir()
after=call(['git','-C',str(repo),'worktree','list','--porcelain'])
assert not cwd.exists() and not stage.exists()
assert 'worktree '+str(cwd)+'\n' not in after
assert supervisor.is_dir() and (supervisor/'status').read_text().strip()=='finished'
print(json.dumps({'status':'EXACT_REMOTE_CWD_AND_STAGING_REMOVED','at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_sha':source,'handle':handle,'execution_checkout':str(cwd),'staging':str(stage),'execution_checkout_disk_absent':True,'staging_disk_absent':True,'execution_checkout_registration_absent':True,'source_and_archive_remote_hashes_verified':expected_hashes,'supervisor_retained':str(supervisor),'steps':steps,'remote_command_wall_s':time.perf_counter()-started}))
